patch.value: Reusable Dependabot merge workflow with complete commit provenance
Replace copied auto-merge logic with a reusable workflow that revokes stale requests and only arms verified Dependabot-only PRs. Companion: pm-cli-website-wis6.

Only pull_request events with Dependabot author and actor plus a complete trusted commit list and allowed metadata can arm squash auto-merge.; Foreign authors or committers, metadata failures, API errors, stale heads and unsupported events cannot arm; existing requests are revoked with sanitized notices and summary.; Execute regression cases for opens, rebases, foreign author, foreign committer, major update, over 100 commits and API failures; verify real fleet commit provenance.; Migrate the own caller, document release SHA pinning and extra groups, regenerate changelog and run package gates.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: No duplicate open item found. Plan: revoke before metadata, load the standalone TypeScript policy only from the reusable workflow commit, check every paginated commit with verified web-flow exception, then arm using an expected-head lease. Real API read of pm-context#211 confirms Dependabot author with verified web-flow committer and a foreign-author/foreign-committer addition. No PR source is checked out or executed. GitHub auto-merge is asynchronous: callers must retain protected-branch checks; revocation on synchronize cannot provide an atomic server-side invariant for future pushes.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Review body unverified provenance claim: no supported forgery demonstrated. GitHub documents createCommitOnBranch (including web commit behavior) as authenticated-user authorship with no custom author/committer; bot verification requires bot/App authentication without custom identity fields. Rebase-and-merge cannot obtain a generic GitHub system signature. Existing corpus rejects foreign committers even when verified and unsigned web-flow/bot attribution; verified Dependabot/web-flow is intentional for real fleet commits. Sources: https://docs.github.com/en/graphql/reference/commits#createcommitonbranch and https://docs.github.com/en/authentication/managing-commit-signature-verification/about-commit-signature-verification . Retaining this documented exception; generic signature validity alone is insufficient, and the policy also enforces author/committer and event identities. GitHub asynchronous merge and compromised credentials remain the previously documented server-protection boundary.

Focused Node and native Bun each pass 85 tests; pinned pm linked runner passed 85. Shell fixtures execute real shortened timeout calls against TERM-resistant finite stalls and retry successes. No thresholds changed; dist is generated and untracked.
